newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraqi labour minister removed from his post.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi labour minister removed from his post.

text.p: Iraq's Minister of Labour and Social Affairs Latif Nsayyif Jassem has been removed from the post so he can devote his time to work for the ruling Baath party, Iraqi newspapers reported on Tuesday.
The papers said the decision was taken at a meeting of the regional command of the party chaired by President Saddam Hussein on Monday.
They said Jassem was relieved of the post in order to dedicate his time to party work. They did not say who would replace him.

"The leadership has decided that comrade Latif Nsayyif Jassem should devote his time to party work...therefore, he is relieved of his post as minister of labour and social affairs," the official al-Qadissiya said.
The paper said a decree to this effect would be issued later.
Jassem, a former information minister, was elected in October senior member to the party's regional command, the highest authority in Iraq after the ruling Revolutionary Command Council.
The paper said the meeting also decided to dismiss any Baath party member involved in usury and said strict punitive measures will be taken against such money lenders.
